newsitem.title: GERMANY: Munich airport sees 9.2pct November passenger rise.
newsitem.headline: Munich airport sees 9.2pct November passenger rise.

text.p: Passenger numbers at Munich airport rose 9.2 percent to 1.3 million in November, airport authority figures showed.
Traffic on international flights increased 13.2 percent to 735,184 passenger while domestic passengers grew 3.7 percent to 541,820.
Total passenger numbers have risen 5.4 percent to 14.6 million, Flughafen Muenchen GmbH said.
This included an 8.4 percent rise in international transport to 8.9 million and a 1.1 percent growth to 5.4 million domestic passengers. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
